capabilities: Format dialogue lines into decorated boxes using the [character]:[options]:[dialogue] namespace syntax
Manage characters with names, aliases, and colors in a character list modal
Customize decorator styling such as border thickness and opacity
Drag dialogue boxes to reposition them
Migrate plugin settings between data.json schema versions
disambiguation: Not a screenplay formatting or export tool; it decorates an informal dialogue syntax, and official script export is still only planned.
extras: The README warns this is an informal way of writing scripts and points users who want formal scripts to screenplay templates; a conversion/export to official scripts is listed only as planned. Settings migrations require a backup beforehand.
motivation: The author wanted to make dialogue pretty so they could visually discern different lines from afar and apply fancy decorations to them.
problem: Plain dialogue lines in scripts are hard to visually tell apart; Obsidian has no way to decorate spoken lines per character.
summary: Dialogue formatter that renders [character]:[options]:[dialogue] lines as colored, decorated, draggable dialogue boxes for informal scripts.
